title: fix(plugin-detail,plugin-dashboard,plugin-grid): the I18nLabel family's batch 2 — record:path stage labels and four registrations accept a locale map (objectui#10993)
body:
Part of #10993
Clause-②: yes

Batch 2 of the family card: the `record:path` raw read is repaired, the registry half is declared, and the docs face is corrected. `RecordPathRenderer` resolves each `stages[].label` locale map with `pickLocalized` against `useObjectTranslation().language` before the stages are translated, classified or drawn, so a spec-valid map no longer crashes the block. `object-metric`'s `label` / `description` / `title`, `object-grid`'s `label` and `record:related_list`'s `title` declare `type: ['string', 'object']`, because their renderers already resolve the map, so `validateTree` no longer reports `type-mismatch` on a legal map. `schema-reference.md` stops calling fourteen of `object-form`'s spec members, the five `I18nLabel` ones batch 1 repaired among them, "ObjectUI extensions with no spec backing". The census table below records every row's standing after this batch.

Held back, per the claim: `object-grid`'s deprecated `title` (the caption fallback in `ObjectGrid.tsx`, serial behind objectui#11026, whose branch edits that file). The 9 never-read members and `ai:chat_window` are the seat's to route. Draft: a dispatched dev's PR (claim comment 5888090052, branch `claude/issue-10993-batch2-i18nlabel-reads`), so ready and landing belong to the seat. Measured at head `a840a1094` on base `e119f120c`.

## What changed

- **`packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-path.tsx`**: `localizeStageLabels` resolves each stage whose `label` is an object with `pickLocalized` against the UI language, inside a memo keyed on `schema.stages` and the language, before the picklist translation, `classify()` and the two rails read it. That covers three reads, not two: `classify()` probes `value + label` for its won/lost tokens, so a map left raw there probed `[object Object]` and a lost stage authored as a map stopped reading as lost. Only the map arm is touched; a string or any other value is handed on as authored, and the input array is returned untouched when no stage carries a map. The picklist translation of the status field still outranks the authored label, as it did for a string.
- **`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx`**: `object-metric`'s `label`, `description` and `title` declare both arms, with descriptions that teach the map. `MetricWidget` resolves `label` (the tile heading) and `description` (the sub-caption); `ObjectMetricWidget` resolves `title` (the drill-down heading, falling back to `label`); all against the UI language.
- **`packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx`**: `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS`' `label` declares both arms. Every read of it in `ObjectGrid` (the caption, the export title, the record-detail overlay heading) resolves with the spec's `resolveI18nLabel` against `useDisplayLocale()`, and the description says so. `view:grid` registers the same inputs, so its declaration carries the same arms; it is not in the public manifest, so no pin row reaches it through that door. `ObjectGrid.tsx` is not touched.
- **`packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`**: `record:related_list`'s `title` declares both arms; `RecordRelatedListRenderer` resolves it with `pickLocalized` against the UI language before its object-label fallback. The same file's cross-file line addresses are re-addressed by content (objectui `AGENTS.md` commandment 11, "When you touch a file anyway, fix the cross-file line addresses inside it"; the seat applied the same rule to batch 1): the `relationshipValueField` / `add` reads in `record-related-list.tsx`, the `picker.valueField` / `picker.labelField` defaults in `RelatedList.tsx` (both addresses had drifted), the `hideFields` read in `record-details.tsx`, the `DetailSection.tsx` empty-section return, the spec's `component.zod.ts` bindings, and the `applyFeedConfig` call shape in `record-activity.tsx`. Comment text only.
- **`content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`**: the `ObjectFormSchema` "Spec alignment & extension keys" bullet that called `submitText`, `cancelText`, `nextText` / `prevText`, `successMessage` and nine more keys "ObjectUI extensions ... with no spec backing yet" is replaced by what the installed spec says (measured below): a "Component-contract keys" class for the fourteen keys that are members of `ComponentPropsMap['object-form']` but not of `FormViewSchema`, and an "Envelope key" class for `className`, which is on `PageComponentSchema`. The `ObjectGridSchema` table gains a `label` row typed `string \| I18nLabel` (the table had no `label` row at all).
- **Tests** (new): `record-path.stageLabelI18nLabel-10993.test.tsx` and `record-related-list.titleI18nLabel-10993.test.tsx` (plugin-detail), `ObjectMetric.i18nLabel-10993.test.tsx` (plugin-dashboard), `ObjectGrid.labelI18nLabel-10993.test.tsx` (plugin-grid), `i18nLabelInputsManifest-10993.test.ts` (console). Every render pin mounts the `{ type, properties }` document through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry under `zh` and `en`, with every map listing `en` first. `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` gains five `MEMBER_PINS` rows (`object-grid.label`, `object-metric.description` / `.label` / `.title`, `record:related_list.title`), and the `record:path.stages` row names the new stage-label pin.
- **`.changeset/10993-batch2-i18nlabel-reads.md`**: `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` and `@object-ui/plugin-grid` minor (each package's registration widens; plugin-detail also carries the renderer repair), with the `Clause-②: yes` line.

## Premise checks

- **The spec rows.** On the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0, `ComponentPropsMap` accepts a locale map and refuses a number (`invalid_union`) at `record:path` `stages[].label`, `object-metric` `label` / `title` / `description`, `object-grid` `label` and `record:related_list` `title`. `view:grid` has no row.
- **The red, before any edit.** Through the real `SchemaRenderer` at base: `{ type: 'record:path', properties: { statusField, stages: [ { value, label: { en, 'zh-CN' } } ] } }` rendered `Component "record:path" failed to render` with "Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {en, zh-CN})".
- **Each widened input's renderer resolves the map** (the `ComponentInput.type` rule: teach the render site, then declare the arm), read at the sites named above and measured by the render pins, which are green on the base renderers too (they are the render half the arms rest on, not repairs). `ObjectGrid`'s fourth `label` read, `columnDiagnosticLabel`, feeds a console diagnostic that keeps the label only when it is a string, so a map is dropped from the message rather than printed.
- **The registry half is complete.** A one-off probe (not committed) walked every installed `ComponentPropsMap` row for top-level members that accept a locale map and a string and refuse a number and an array, and read each one's registered input: 29 members, 28 declare both arms at this head, and the 29th is `object-grid.title`, which is deliberately not declared (the ruled carve-out for the deprecated spelling).
- **Mechanism assumption 1, measured and not followed.** The dispatch suggested routing `stages[].label` through the resolver the block's `aria` name uses (`resolveI18nLabel` against `useDisplayLocale()`). The stage label is resolved with `pickLocalized` against `useObjectTranslation().language` instead: it is the source every other visible `record:*` label in this package uses (`record:related_list.title`, `record:alert.title`, `record:details` sections), the card's direction, and the language `t()` composes the stage's accessible name in, so the name never mixes a regional-locale label with UI-language state words. The two resolvers agree limb for limb; only the locale source differs.
- **Serial check.** `claude/issue-11026-number-use-grouping` (fetched into a private ref) edits neither `plugin-grid/src/index.tsx` nor `plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`; no serial conflict.

## Evidence

All runs at `a840a1094` unless a line says otherwise, through the shared verify lock on a shared box.

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/`: `Test Files 220 passed | 1 skipped (221)`, `Tests 2159 passed | 8 skipped (2167)`.
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/`: `Test Files 152 passed (152)`, `Tests 1385 passed | 6 skipped (1391)`.
- `packages/plugin-grid/`: `Test Files 166 passed (166)`, `Tests 1543 passed (1543)`.
- The registry-reading suites: the 16 console files that import `register-plugins` (the parity gate and the three I18nLabel manifest pins among them), cli `registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859`, `spec-vocabulary-hint` and `validate-union-arm-selection`, and schema-catalog `catalog-gallery-render` and `safe-validate-corpus-6318`: `Test Files 21 passed (21)`, `Tests 1022 passed (1022)`.
- `turbo run build` over the three packages' dependency closure (14 tasks), then `pnpm --filter` `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) for `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` and `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, joined by `&&`: exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` in each package lists the new pins (2, 1 and 1), so the type-check covers them; each part exited 0.
- Gates, each exit 0 at this head: `check-changeset-presence`, `changeset:check`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:phantom-deps`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 12 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- ESLint, narrowed and proven: the population is the config's own `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']` block over `tseslint.configs.recommended`; `--format json` over the 10 changed code files reports 10 files, 0 errors, 67 warnings, 1 of them on a line this branch adds: `react-hooks/preserve-manual-memoization` on the `stages` memo in `record-path.tsx`, whose type annotation this PR edits. Linting the base blob reports the same rule on the same memo. The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions`, `projectService` or `TypeChecked` in `eslint.config.js`) and no `eslint-rules/` rule reads another file, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

**Red on base, then green.** The fix files were committed, then the four source files (`plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-grid` and `plugin-detail` `src/index.tsx`, and `record-path.tsx`) were replaced on disk by their `e119f120c` blobs inside the verify lock, under a trap-restore, at `2ef598299` (hashes equal to the base blobs; `objectui#10993` mentions 0 in each index file, `localizeStageLabels` 0). `Tests 16 failed | 225 passed (241)` over the six pin files: the manifest pin's 5 arm rows (`expected [ 'string' ] to deeply equal [ 'object', 'string' ]`) and 5 map rows (a `type-mismatch` warning where none is expected) failed while its 3 reachability, 5 string and 5 number controls passed; the `record:path` pin's 5 map rows failed on `Component "record:path" failed to render` while its string control passed; the parity gate failed exactly `every member pin names a key that is still array/object-armed on a covered block`, naming the five new rows; and the `object-metric`, `object-grid` and `record:related_list` render pins stayed green, as predicted, because those renderers resolved the map already. Restored: hashes equal the HEAD blobs, `git diff HEAD` empty. The one later commit, `a840a1094`, rewrites `localizeStageLabels`' loop only, and the mutated tree is the base blobs either way.

## Acceptance notes

- **NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-closure` / Bundle Analysis and `check:sdui-registration-pins`.** Reason: both need a full console build. The five input descriptions add text to registrations the console loads eagerly.
- **NOT MEASURED: `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples`.** Reason: not run; they need the full package set built. The doc edit adds a table row and bullet text, no fenced snippet.
- **NOT MEASURED: `apps/console` type-check.** Reason: its dependency closure was not built here. The console change is two test files; the new one copies the shape of batch 1's `objectFormI18nLabelManifest.test.ts`. CI's type-check is the reading.
- **The TS face stays narrower than the spec, and this batch leaves it.** In `@object-ui/types` (`record-components.ts`), `RecordPathComponentProps.stages[].label`, `RecordRelatedListComponentProps.title` and `.add.label`, and `RecordDetailsComponentProps.sections[].label` are typed `string` where the spec row says `I18nLabel`. The renderers resolve the map at runtime, so nothing crashes, but a TypeScript author who writes the spec's map gets a compile error. `packages/types` is outside this claim; named in the report for the seat as this card's TS face.
- **`record:path`'s `stages` description promises what the renderer does not do.** The registration says "Explicit stage definitions [{ value, label }] (else derived from field metadata)", echoing the spec's "(if not using field metadata)". A one-off probe (not committed): `{ type: 'record:path', properties: { statusField: 'stage' } }` through `SchemaRenderer`, in a record context whose adapter declares the `stage` picklist, renders "record:path — no stages configured", with no list items and no `getObjectSchema` call. Only the synthesized default page derives stages. This PR does not edit that description (a different defect). Reported to the seat.
- **Cross-file line addresses**: repaired in `plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`, the registration file this PR edits (see What changed). `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`, where this PR adds five rows as batch 1 added seven, carries 13 lines with such addresses in its prose and exemption reasons. They are left as batch 1 left them, because repairing them is outside this card; carrier: none.
- **`view:grid`** shares `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS`, so its `label` declares both arms too. It is not in `getPublicConfigs()`'s manifest, so the manifest pin has no row for it.
- **`main` moved during the run** by four commits (to `3e71a9825`), none touching this PR's files. It is not merged in, because the queue rebuilds on `main`. objectui#11051's PR 11078 landed as `a4b017eda`, which is why the census marks the `element:*` `aria.ariaLabel` row done.
